run_asr_etox_cli: run the ASR ETOX CLI to compute toxicity levels of speech inputs from a TSV manifest
build_data_pipeline: build a data pipeline that decodes audio files, converts to fbank features, and batches them for inference
get_text_from_audio: get transcribed text from audio examples using either Whisper or seamlessM4T translator models
check_toxicity_with_etox: check text for toxic bad words using the ETOX bad word checker for a given language
run_asr_etox_with_whisper: run ASR ETOX with a Whisper model to transcribe and assess toxicity of multilingual speech inputs
